commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Git pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking

# Run mypy on all Python files in src/
echo "Running mypy type checking on src/..."
mypy src/

# Check exit code
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Error: mypy type checking failed. Commit blocked."
    exit 1
fi

echo "mypy type checking passed."
exit 0
EOF

cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Git pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking on staged files

echo "Running mypy type checking on staged Python files..."

# Get staged Python files
STAGED_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep "\.py$")

# If no Python files are staged, exit successfully
if [ -z "$STAGED_FILES" ]; then
    echo "No Python files staged for commit."
    exit 0
fi

echo "Checking files: $STAGED_FILES"

# Run mypy on staged files
mypy --show-error-codes $STAGED_FILES

# Check exit code
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Error: mypy type checking failed. Commit blocked."
    exit 1
fi

echo "mypy type checking passed."
exit 0
EOF

echo "=== Setup Summary ===" && echo "1. py.typed marker file:" && ls -la src/py.typed && echo -e "
2. Pre-commit hook location:" && ls -la .git/hooks/pre-commit && echo -e "
3. Hook content:" && head -5 .git/hooks/pre-commit && echo "..." && tail -5 .git/hooks/pre-commit && echo -e "
4. Git log:" && git log --oneline -3
